scientific_integrity: The proof uses explicit Plucker-chart isomorphisms. Finite lattice and GF(2) checks independently corroborate but do not constitute the unrestricted proof. Published general methods for smoothness, multiplicity, and Gorensteinness are acknowledged; no claim of independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Complex rank-two maximal components individually; excludes singular scheme/intersections of the full reducible union, higher ranks, and historical-priority certification.
title: Determinantal transverse cones on every rank-two quasisymmetric Grassmannian component
